name: UTS Financial Support Grant
summary: Non-repayable grant for low-income UTS students to cover course costs or essential living costs such as rent or utility arrears.
key: Grants are usually approved for amounts up to $500.
who: Combined income under $1,200 per fortnight and inadequate savings
Evidence of course costs or essential living costs
how: Apply online in the student portal under Financial Assistance Application
For urgent needs call SSU reception on 02 9514 1177
catches: Paid to an Australian bank account, usually within about 10 days
Not open to UTS College, non-award, inbound exchange or leave-of-absence students
First-session students can apply only after census date

evidence.quote: Successful grant applications are usually approved for amounts up-to $500
